+++ b/tests/test_defender_attribution.py
@@ -0,0 +1,414 @@
+"""Focused regression: every configured opponent joins latest-touch attribution.
+
+Reproduced omission (docs/outcome-probe-01.md): ``_scenario_observe_touches``
+records every configured bot into ``seen_touch``, but ``_scenario`` built its
+attribution list from the human and the optional keeper only. A fresh later
+defender touch therefore reached ``seen_touch`` yet never entered
+``latest_touch``, so the strict latest-human comparison could not see it and an
+invalid Human success was awarded on both the Active (3) and GoalScored (4)
+goal-edge paths.
+
+These tests drive the real public flow only:
+
+    TrainingEngine(...) -> update() settle -> ready -> go -> human touch
+    -> [opponent touch] -> [human retouch] -> goal edge -> drain
+
+No engine state, method, metric, clock or event list is written by the tests;
+``scenario_state``/``_emitted``/``outcome`` are read only. Every frame is a
+synthetic packet: no game, network, process or physics simulation is involved.
+The roster fixture is authored locally (full roster in index order) instead of
+reusing the keeper-only ``_frame`` helper in ``test_power_shot_scenarios.py``,
+because that helper omits the defender actor that this regression is about.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+import pytest
+
+from my_career_training.training.engine import TrainingEngine
+
+LESSON_ID = "power-shots"
+SCENARIO_ID = "low-side-pass"
+DT = 1 / 120
+SETTLE_START = 1.0
+MAX_SETTLE_FRAMES = 400
+GOAL_PLANE_Y = 5120.0
+SHOT_STEPS = 24
+OPPONENT_TOUCH_STEP = 6
+HUMAN_RETOUCH_STEP = 12
+DRAIN_FRAMES = 40
+PHASES = (3, 4)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Synthetic full-roster packets
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _actions():
+    return {
+        "throttle": 0.0, "steer": 0.0, "pitch": 0.0, "yaw": 0.0, "roll": 0.0,
+        "jump": False, "boost": False, "handbrake": False,
+    }
+
+
+def _actor(pose, index, team, is_bot, touch=None):
+    actor = copy.deepcopy(pose)
+    actor.update({
+        "index": index, "player_index": index, "team": team, "is_bot": is_bot,
+        "wheel_contact": True, "air_state": "OnGround",
+        "has_jumped": False, "has_double_jumped": False, "has_dodged": False,
+        "actions": _actions(),
+    })
+    if touch is not None:
+        actor["latest_touch"] = {
+            "game_seconds": touch,
+            "location": [0.0, 0.0, 93.0],
+            "normal": [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
+            "ball_index": 0,
+        }
+    return actor
+
+
+def _frame(engine, t, *, setup="settle", touches=None, scores=(0, 0), ball=None,
+           phase=3):
+    """One packet carrying the exact full roster in index order.
+
+    ``touches`` is keyed by roster position, which is also the actor's
+    ``index``/``player_index``: the engine reads scenario actors positionally
+    via ``cars[index]``, so position and index must agree exactly.
+    """
+    state = engine.lesson["starting_state" if setup == "starting" else "settle_state"]
+    touches = touches or {}
+    cars = []
+    for position in range(engine.human_index + 1):
+        if position == engine.human_index:
+            pose, team, is_bot = state["car"], 0, False
+        else:
+            pose, team, is_bot = state["bots"][position], 1, True
+        cars.append(_actor(pose, position, team, is_bot, touches.get(position)))
+
+    assert len(cars) == engine.human_index + 1, "roster array is not the full roster"
+    for position, actor in enumerate(cars):
+        assert actor["index"] == position, "roster index mismatch"
+        assert actor["player_index"] == position, "roster player_index mismatch"
+
+    value = copy.deepcopy(state["ball"])
+    if ball:
+        value.update(ball)
+    return {
+        "time": t,
+        "dt": DT,
+        "frame_num": int(round(t / DT)),
+        "phase": phase,
+        "car": cars[engine.human_index],
+        "cars": cars,
+        "ball": value,
+        "scores": list(scores),
+        "actions": _actions(),
+        "packet_gap": False,
+    }
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Public init/update flow
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _engine(difficulty="diamond"):
+    return TrainingEngine(LESSON_ID, scenario_id=SCENARIO_ID, difficulty=difficulty)
+
+
+def _prepare(engine, *, pre_reset_defender_touch=False):
+    """Settle -> ready -> go. Returns the absolute ``go`` time."""
+    defender = engine.scenario["roles"].get("defender")
+    t = SETTLE_START
+    for _ in range(MAX_SETTLE_FRAMES):
+        touches = {}
+        if pre_reset_defender_touch and defender is not None:
+            # A touch observed before the reset is frozen into baseline_touch at
+            # "go" and must never be counted as this attempt's contact.
+            touches[defender] = t
+        engine.update(_frame(engine, t, touches=touches))
+        if engine.state == "ready":
+            break
+        t += DT
+    assert engine.state == "ready", "the synthetic settle pose was rejected"
+
+    go_time = t + DT
+    events = engine.update(_frame(engine, go_time, setup="starting"))
+    assert engine.state == "active", "the go packet did not start the attempt"
+    assert [event["type"] for event in events] == ["go"]
+    return go_time
+
+
+def _drive(engine, *, goal_phase=3, opponent=None,
+           opponent_step=OPPONENT_TOUCH_STEP, opponent_stamp=None,
+           human_retouch_step=None, pre_reset_defender_touch=False):
+    """Prepare the attempt, then drive it. Returns the injected timeline."""
+    go_time = _prepare(engine, pre_reset_defender_touch=pre_reset_defender_touch)
+    return _drive_from(engine, go_time, goal_phase=goal_phase, opponent=opponent,
+                       opponent_step=opponent_step, opponent_stamp=opponent_stamp,
+                       human_retouch_step=human_retouch_step)
+
+
+def _drive_from(engine, go_time, *, goal_phase=3, opponent=None,
+                opponent_step=OPPONENT_TOUCH_STEP, opponent_stamp=None,
+                human_retouch_step=None):
+    """Drive an already-prepared attempt and return the injected timeline.
+
+    ``opponent`` is a scenario role name (``"defender"``/``"keeper"``) or None.
+    ``opponent_stamp`` overrides the injected stamp so an equal-time tie can be
+    expressed; by default the opponent touches at the frame it is delivered in.
+    """
+    injections = []
+
+    human_stamp = go_time + DT
+    t = human_stamp
+    injections.append({"role": "human", "index": engine.human_index,
+                       "stamp": human_stamp})
+    engine.update(_frame(engine, t, setup="starting",
+                         touches={engine.human_index: human_stamp}))
+
+    opponent_index = None
+    if opponent is not None:
+        opponent_index = engine.scenario["roles"][opponent]
+
+    target = engine.lesson["targets"][0]
+    goal_point = [target["center_x"], GOAL_PLANE_Y, 300.0]
+    pre_goal = [target["center_x"], GOAL_PLANE_Y - 20.0, 300.0]
+    origin = list(engine.lesson["starting_state"]["ball"]["position"])
+    velocity = [(b - a) / (SHOT_STEPS * DT) for a, b in zip(origin, pre_goal)]
+
+    for step in range(1, SHOT_STEPS + 1):
+        fraction = step / SHOT_STEPS
+        position = [a + (b - a) * fraction for a, b in zip(origin, pre_goal)]
+        touches = {}
+        if opponent_index is not None and step == opponent_step:
+            stamp = t + DT if opponent_stamp is None else opponent_stamp
+            touches[opponent_index] = stamp
+            injections.append({"role": opponent, "index": opponent_index,
+                               "stamp": stamp})
+        if human_retouch_step is not None and step == human_retouch_step:
+            stamp = t + DT
+            touches[engine.human_index] = stamp
+            injections.append({"role": "human", "index": engine.human_index,
+                               "stamp": stamp})
+        t += DT
+        engine.update(_frame(engine, t, setup="starting", touches=touches,
+                             ball={"position": position, "velocity": velocity}))
+
+    # Goal edge: phase 3 is the ordinary Active branch, phase 4 the GoalScored
+    # terminal branch. Both are real source paths.
+    t += DT
+    engine.update(_frame(engine, t, setup="starting", phase=goal_phase,
+                         scores=(1, 0),
+                         ball={"position": goal_point, "velocity": velocity}))
+    goal_time = t
+
+    for _ in range(DRAIN_FRAMES):
+        if engine.finished:
+            break
+        t += DT
+        engine.update(_frame(engine, t, setup="starting", scores=(1, 0),
+                             ball={"position": goal_point, "velocity": velocity}))
+
+    return {
+        "engine": engine,
+        "injections": injections,
+        "go_time": go_time,
+        "human_stamp": human_stamp,
+        "goal_time": goal_time,
+    }
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Read-only evidence helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _succeeded(engine):
+    return engine.outcome == "success" and "scenario_success" in engine._emitted
+
+
+def _stamp(result, role):
+    return next(item["stamp"] for item in result["injections"] if item["role"] == role)
+
+
+def _index(result, role):
+    return next(item["index"] for item in result["injections"] if item["role"] == role)
+
+
+def _assert_roster(engine, *, defender):
+    roles = engine.scenario["roles"]
+    assert roles["keeper"] == 0
+    assert roles["human"] == engine.human_index
+    if defender:
+        assert roles["defender"] == 1
+        assert engine.bot_indices == [0, 1]
+        assert engine.human_index == 2
+    else:
+        assert "defender" not in roles
+        assert engine.bot_indices == [0]
+        assert engine.human_index == 1
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Positive controls
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_human_only_attempt_succeeds_on_both_goal_edge_phases(goal_phase):
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    result = _drive(engine, goal_phase=goal_phase)
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    assert _succeeded(engine), engine.outcome
+    assert state["seen_touch"][engine.human_index] == result["human_stamp"]
+    # Exactly the human is attributed: no phantom opponent entry appears.
+    assert state["latest_touch"] == {engine.human_index: result["human_stamp"]}
+    assert state["human_touch"] == result["human_stamp"]
+    assert state["keeper_touch"] is None
+    assert state["goal_target_time"] is not None
+    assert state["score_edge"] is not None
+
+
+def test_lower_rank_without_a_defender_still_succeeds():
+    """Positive control: Gold has a keeper but no defender actor at all."""
+    engine = _engine("gold")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=False)
+    result = _drive(engine, goal_phase=3)
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    assert _succeeded(engine), engine.outcome
+    assert state["latest_touch"] == {engine.human_index: result["human_stamp"]}
+    assert state["keeper_touch"] is None
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The reproduced omission: a fresh later defender touch must block success
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_later_defender_touch_blocks_success_on_both_goal_edge_phases(goal_phase):
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    result = _drive(engine, goal_phase=goal_phase, opponent="defender")
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    defender_index = _index(result, "defender")
+    defender_stamp = _stamp(result, "defender")
+    human_stamp = result["human_stamp"]
+
+    # The supplied role/index and the fresh ordered stamp really reached the
+    # engine: it is in the roster scan and it is newer than the human touch.
+    assert defender_index == 1
+    assert state["seen_touch"][defender_index] == defender_stamp
+    assert defender_stamp > human_stamp
+    assert state["human_touch"] == human_stamp
+    # The fix: the defender is now part of latest-touch attribution.
+    assert state["latest_touch"][defender_index] == defender_stamp
+    assert state["latest_touch"][engine.human_index] == human_stamp
+
+    assert not _succeeded(engine), "a later defender touch must not award success"
+    assert engine.outcome != "success"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_equal_time_defender_tie_is_ambiguous_and_blocks_success(goal_phase):
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    # The tie stamp is the human stamp, known only after the go packet, so the
+    # attempt is prepared first and then driven with that explicit stamp.
+    go_time = _prepare(engine)
+    human_stamp = go_time + DT
+    result = _drive_from(engine, go_time, goal_phase=goal_phase,
+                         opponent="defender", opponent_stamp=human_stamp)
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    defender_index = _index(result, "defender")
+    assert state["seen_touch"][defender_index] == human_stamp
+    assert state["latest_touch"][defender_index] == human_stamp
+    assert state["latest_touch"][engine.human_index] == human_stamp
+    # Strictly-later is required, so an equal stamp is never treated as older.
+    assert not _succeeded(engine), "an equal-time defender tie must not award success"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_later_keeper_touch_remains_blocked(goal_phase):
+    """Unchanged behaviour: the keeper was already attributed before the fix."""
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    result = _drive(engine, goal_phase=goal_phase, opponent="keeper")
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    keeper_index = _index(result, "keeper")
+    keeper_stamp = _stamp(result, "keeper")
+    assert keeper_index == 0
+    assert state["seen_touch"][keeper_index] == keeper_stamp
+    assert state["latest_touch"][keeper_index] == keeper_stamp
+    assert state["keeper_touch"] == keeper_stamp
+    assert keeper_stamp > result["human_stamp"]
+    assert not _succeeded(engine), "a later keeper touch must not award success"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_human_retouch_after_an_older_defender_touch_can_succeed(goal_phase):
+    """Existing policy permits success when the Human is again the latest."""
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    result = _drive(engine, goal_phase=goal_phase, opponent="defender",
+                    human_retouch_step=HUMAN_RETOUCH_STEP)
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    defender_index = _index(result, "defender")
+    defender_stamp = _stamp(result, "defender")
+    retouch_stamp = result["injections"][-1]["stamp"]
+    assert result["injections"][-1]["role"] == "human"
+    assert retouch_stamp > defender_stamp
+
+    assert state["latest_touch"][defender_index] == defender_stamp
+    assert state["latest_touch"][engine.human_index] == retouch_stamp
+    assert _succeeded(engine), engine.outcome
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_pre_reset_defender_touch_is_excluded_and_does_not_block(goal_phase):
+    """The baseline exclusion still applies: a stale defender touch is not fresh."""
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    go_time = _prepare(engine, pre_reset_defender_touch=True)
+    defender_index = engine.scenario["roles"]["defender"]
+    stale = engine.scenario_state["baseline_touch"][defender_index]
+    assert stale < go_time
+
+    # Re-deliver the identical pre-reset stamp during the attempt: it must be
+    # skipped as pre-reset, so it never enters latest-touch attribution.
+    result = _drive_from(engine, go_time, goal_phase=goal_phase,
+                         opponent="defender", opponent_stamp=stale)
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    assert _stamp(result, "defender") == stale
+    assert state["seen_touch"][defender_index] == stale
+    assert defender_index not in state["latest_touch"]
+    assert _succeeded(engine), engine.outcome
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("goal_phase", PHASES)
+def test_future_defender_stamp_is_excluded_and_does_not_block(goal_phase):
+    """A stamp after the observing packet is not yet evidence."""
+    engine = _engine("diamond")
+    _assert_roster(engine, defender=True)
+    go_time = _prepare(engine)
+    human_stamp = go_time + DT
+    future = human_stamp + 10.0
+
+    result = _drive_from(engine, go_time, goal_phase=goal_phase,
+                         opponent="defender", opponent_stamp=future)
+    state = engine.scenario_state
+
+    defender_index = engine.scenario["roles"]["defender"]
+    assert _stamp(result, "defender") == future
+    assert state["seen_touch"][defender_index] == future
+    assert defender_index not in state["latest_touch"]
+    assert _succeeded(engine), engine.outcome
